status: FROZEN before any X2-WIDE signal count or outcome
nature: cross-symbol transfer test of an unchanged rule; not a fresh temporal holdout; not a new independent strategy; research only, no engine/runtime/account change

rule.tuning: none; any change is a new candidate

arms.original8: D01 original9 minus BTCUSDT (BTC is context only)
arms.extra31: D01 extra31 (8 of them are consumed by the H5 pilot only, not by X2)

data.bars: 4h UTC bins built from 1h; a bin needs all four 1h bars

execution.entry: next 1h open after the 4h decision close; must be exactly 1 h after the decision bar's last 1h bar
execution.fills: reference x (1 +/- 2 bp) adverse; fees 5/13/21 bp of each fill's notional (7/15/23 bp per side total)
execution.funding_proxy: 1 bp / 8 h x qty open at the start of the management bar x every held 1h close incl. the exit bar; cost on both sides; not native funding
execution.partial: floor(qty*0.5/step)*step at +1R from the entry fill; only if both parts meet min_qty and min_notional, else blocked (breakeven still arms)
execution.breakeven: stop -> entry fill from the NEXT management bar after +1R is reached (never retroactive)

paths.causal: 1h management bars; adverse open gap exits at the open; stop-first when stop and a target share a 1h bar
paths.worst: 4h management bars with the same rules: all ambiguity inside 4 h resolves stop-first; breakeven from the next 4h bar

execution.exit_times: gap at the bar open; stop/target/partial/time at the management bar close; time cap = first bar with close >= entry + 120 h
execution.liquidity: D01 point-in-time rule (prior 30 complete UTC days median quote volume >= $10m and >= 720 consecutive bars), alt only, at the decision's last 1h bar
execution.daily_halt: Cairo-day net realized cash <= -$120 blocks new decisions that Cairo day (entry fee on entry day, partial on its day, rest on exit day)
execution.equal_boundary: an exit at or before a decision close frees the slot for that decision
execution.terminal_open: reserves the slot to the end, marked at the last close with exit costs, excluded from closes

gates_for_paper_review.if_undersampled_or_fragile: mark forward-only; never weaken a gate to rescue
